# Vendored browser dependencies

These pinned browser bundles are served locally so parsing works without a third-party CDN at runtime.

| Package | Version | Upstream | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SheetJS Community Edition | 0.18.5 | [github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs](https://github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs) | [LICENSE](xlsx.LICENSE) |
| Papa Parse | 5.4.1 | [github.com/mholt/PapaParse](https://github.com/mholt/PapaParse) | [LICENSE](papaparse.LICENSE) |

To upgrade, review the upstream project and license, replace the bundle, update this inventory, and review the browser policy if the integration changes. These versions are pinned as supplied by the attached app source; assess current upstream advisories before production use.
